reason: The cited evidence shows that CrMnFeCoNi fails to form protective Cr2O3 and instead forms Mn-rich oxides (E2, E3), supporting the need for a better scale. However, none of the cited passages provide any data on Al addition, α-Al2O3 formation, or its effect on oxidation or spallation in this alloy system, leaving the core premises about the intervention unsupported.
premises: CrMnFeCoNi bond coat lacks a protective Cr2O3 scale at high temperature, leading to non-protective Mn-rich oxides
